 Singtel Group CEO Yuen Kuan Moon Sells 2 Million Shares for About S$8.15 Million
 By George Yang - 2026-11-14 , 3:05 pm 
 Singtel Group CEO Yuen Kuan Moon sold 2 million shares in the telco on the open market for about S$8.15 million.
 Singtel disclosed the change in his holdings in a Singapore Exchange (SGX) filing on Saturday (14 November 2026). Lianhe Zaobao reported that Yuen sold the shares at an average price of S$4.074 each.
 Yuen’s Stake Fell From 0.085% to 0.073%
 After the sale, Yuen held 11,875,466 Singtel shares. He held 7,737,969 directly and 4,137,497 indirectly. The sale reduced his direct holdings by 2 million shares.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 Singtel shares closed at S$4.11 on Friday (13 November), down 0.96% for the day.
